title: NumberBlocks MathLink Cubes 93417 Number Blocks, 1-10 Cubes, 100 Piece Activity Set, Math Toy, Authentic

reviews.title: Great toy to build math skills for preschoolers
reviews.body: This was my 3 year olds most requested toy since he loved watching number blocks. The packaging was great and everything was neatly organized. It had all the number blocks, face plates, number cards and activity cards. My son spent a good amount of time building all the number blocks and rearranging them. We also had fun doing the activity cards which is directly from the tv show so it was really exciting for him. The blocks are well made and easy to grip and lock in. After you build it they are sturdy and does not fall off. It was worth the money!

reviews.title: As a teacher I recommend
reviews.body: Number Blocks math manipulatives are an exceptionally effective tool for introducing young children to foundational mathematical concepts. Their playful design, featuring characters that visually represent numerical values, immediately captures a child's attention and makes learning engaging. Each Number Block corresponds to a number, and their physical size and connectivity help illustrate key concepts like addition, subtraction, and place value. Children can manipulate these blocks to create various configurations, fostering hands-on learning that cements understanding better than abstract concepts alone. The tactile experience, combined with the appealing character designs, transforms math from a potentially daunting subject into an enjoyable exploration. This method of learning caters to different learning styles, particularly kinesthetic and visual learners, by providing a concrete representation of numbers. Additionally, the blocks encourage problem-solving and critical thinking as children figure out how to combine and separate them to achieve desired outcomes. Overall, Number Blocks are a fantastic resource for making early math education both effective and fun.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 29, 2025
